scope: post hoc presentation and reference-shift analysis only; no sampling or protocol change

W1_quadrature.integration: Tensor Gauss-Legendre in the whitened square [-R,R]^2; beta>0 integrated separately with a variable lower z2 boundary and z1 intervals split where that boundary crosses +/-R.
W1_quadrature.tail_control: Global log-concavity supporting planes on radius-R directions bound omitted mass outside the square by a sector-wise integral outside the inscribed disk; also bound absolute polynomial moment tails.
W1_quadrature.error_interpretation: Report every order/radius result, order and domain differences, and floating-point evaluations of analytic tail inequalities. No interval arithmetic is implemented; grid stability and evaluated tail bounds are not a certified total quadrature error or exact truth.

W1_mcmc_replication: One upstream Stan generation with ten chains, each storing 1000 thinned correlated draws; neither 10000 independent experiments nor ten independent generation studies.

interpretation.formula: D(c+e)=D(c)-2*e*(mean_A-mean_B), same common set and same s_f=1
interpretation.W1_long_budget: All six continuous function point differences favour the specified NUTS workflow for every saved quadrature and the independent MCMC reference point; all six can reverse within the hypothetical +/-2 MCMC-MCSE shift. No certified quadrature-error radius is available.
interpretation.rare_event: All W1 fitted event estimates are zero. The nonzero squared discrepancy is the square of the common numerical reference, not evidence of resolved event estimation.
